format.L/R: 2D joints, flat [x0,y0,...,x20,y20] per frame, normalised by w/h; null where the hand was not detected. Values leave 0..1 when a hand leaves frame.
format.L3/R3: depth-grounded 3D joints, flat [x0,y0,z0,...] per frame, in integer millimetres in the clip's estimated body frame -- x lateral, y up, z forward out of the torso -- NOT camera coordinates: the extraction pipeline rewrites the metric camera-frame joints into that frame as its last step. null where the hand was not detected or its 3D was not depth-grounded, so a frame can have 2D joints and no 3D.
